title: AZ-900 · Describe Azure compute services · Module assessment

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure Virtual Machine?

options.text: An IaaS compute resource that provides control over the guest operating system and installed software
Keeping application data in Azure-hosted sessions instead of on endpoint devices
An application-hosting approach that provides maximum control over the operating system and environment
A PaaS option for running individual containers quickly without managing virtual machines

questions.explanation: Azure Virtual Machine is an IaaS compute resource that provides control over the guest operating system and installed software.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does VM image refer to?

options.text: A stateful extension in which the runtime coordinates and tracks state across function activity
An Azure offering for generative AI scenarios such as chat and content generation
A template that can include an operating system and preinstalled components for rapid VM deployment
A model in which developers focus on code while the platform manages the underlying servers and scaling

questions.explanation: VM image is a template that can include an operating system and preinstalled components for rapid VM deployment.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: Which description correctly matches B-series VM?

options.text: Keeping application data in Azure-hosted sessions instead of on endpoint devices
Managing container deployment, scaling, networking, and lifecycle across many instances
A burstable, cost-efficient VM family suited to workloads with occasional CPU spikes
A stateful extension in which the runtime coordinates and tracks state across function activity

questions.explanation: B-series VM is a burstable, cost-efficient VM family suited to workloads with occasional CPU spikes.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of D-series VM?

options.text: A managed Kubernetes service used to orchestrate and manage fleets of containers
A general-purpose VM family suited to common application and web-server workloads
Keeping application data in Azure-hosted sessions instead of on endpoint devices
A stateful extension in which the runtime coordinates and tracks state across function activity

questions.explanation: D-series VM is a general-purpose VM family suited to common application and web-server workloads.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: What is the primary meaning of E-series VM in Azure fundamentals?

options.text: A PaaS option for running individual containers quickly without managing virtual machines
Automated application deployment from sources such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, or other Git repositories
A memory-optimized VM family suited to memory-intensive workloads
A trigger that runs a function according to a schedule

questions.explanation: E-series VM is a memory-optimized VM family suited to memory-intensive workloads.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Azure Virtual Machine: an IaaS compute resource that provides control over the guest operating system and installed software.
VM image: a GPU-enabled VM family suited to graphics and AI workloads.
Azure Virtual Machine: a general-purpose VM family suited to common application and web-server workloads.
VM image: a template that can include an operating system and preinstalled components for rapid VM deployment.
B-series VM: a managed Azure service that provides virtual Windows desktops and applications to remote users.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Azure Virtual Machine — an IaaS compute resource that provides control over the guest operating system and installed software; and VM image — a template that can include an operating system and preinstalled components for rapid VM deployment.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: Which TWO statements accurately reflect the concepts covered in this unit?

options.text: D-series VM: a VM resiliency feature that separates instances across fault domains and update domains within a region.
B-series VM: a burstable, cost-efficient VM family suited to workloads with occasional CPU spikes.
D-series VM: a general-purpose VM family suited to common application and web-server workloads.
D-series VM: hosting desktops and applications in Azure rather than storing all application state on local user devices.
B-series VM: a compute-optimized VM family suited to CPU-intensive workloads.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: B-series VM — a burstable, cost-efficient VM family suited to workloads with occasional CPU spikes; and D-series VM — a general-purpose VM family suited to common application and web-server workloads.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: Select TWO correct statements about the material in this Microsoft Learn unit.

options.text: F-series VM: a compute-optimized VM family suited to CPU-intensive workloads.
E-series VM: a service for managing groups of similar load-balanced VMs that can scale instance count.
E-series VM: a memory-optimized VM family suited to memory-intensive workloads.
E-series VM: using Azure identity and access controls for virtual desktop users.
F-series VM: hosting desktops and applications in Azure rather than storing all application state on local user devices.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: E-series VM — a memory-optimized VM family suited to memory-intensive workloads; and F-series VM — a compute-optimized VM family suited to CPU-intensive workloads.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: Which TWO statements are consistent with the unit content?

options.text: Virtual Machine Scale Set: a service for managing groups of similar load-balanced VMs that can scale instance count.
N-series VM: a managed Azure service that provides virtual Windows desktops and applications to remote users.
Virtual Machine Scale Set: allowing multiple users to share Windows session-host infrastructure when appropriate.
N-series VM: a GPU-enabled VM family suited to graphics and AI workloads.
F-series VM: allowing multiple users to share Windows session-host infrastructure when appropriate.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: N-series VM — a GPU-enabled VM family suited to graphics and AI workloads; and Virtual Machine Scale Set — a service for managing groups of similar load-balanced VMs that can scale instance count.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.question: Choose the TWO accurate statements.

options.text: Availability set: a VM resiliency feature that separates instances across fault domains and update domains within a region.
N-series VM: providing a dedicated session experience for a user when workload needs require it.
Azure Virtual Desktop: providing standardized desktops and apps to remote, contractor, or hybrid users.
Azure Virtual Desktop: a managed Azure service that provides virtual Windows desktops and applications to remote users.
Availability set: using Azure identity and access controls for virtual desktop users.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Availability set — a VM resiliency feature that separates instances across fault domains and update domains within a region; and Azure Virtual Desktop — a managed Azure service that provides virtual Windows desktops and applications to remote users.
